title: 第一卷 第3章 昨晚，好像不是梦
content_zh:
童喻做了个梦。

    梦见自己当了回流氓，勾了个好看的男人不放。

    梦里，全是她平日里不敢想的那些画面，她分不清是真，还是假。

    她动了动，除了头有点疼，身体也有些不适感。

    挣扎着睁开了眼睛，阳光有点刺眼，她把手臂横在眼睛上。

    只稍片刻，她就发现不对劲了。

    她那破出租屋，西晒，根本就见不到早上的太阳。

    这，不是她家。

    童喻终于清醒了些，脑子快速运转，回忆着昨晚发生事。

    一幕幕在脑子里浮现，最后只剩下一个名字。

    霍放！

    有些记忆涌上来，越来越清醒。

    她猛地看向身边，男人那张好看的脸在眼前放大。

    呼吸一窒。

    那不是梦！

    童喻终于意识到自己干了什么事，脑子还没想好要怎么办的时候，身体已经做好了决定。

    她下了床，捡起地上的衣服，捂着胸口光着脚赶紧出去，生怕会被里面的人叫住。

    在门口穿好了衣服，憋着一股劲出了门。

    ……

    童喻到【云上】上班。

    一连三天，童喻都没见到霍放。

    想着他那样的人，应该也不会天天来这种地方。
content_en:
Tong Yu had a dream.

    I dreamed that I had become a gangster and seduced a good-looking man.

    The dream was filled with scenes that she didn't dare to think about on a daily basis. She couldn't tell whether they were real or fake.

    She moved, and besides her head hurting a little, she also felt a little uncomfortable in her body.

    She struggled to open her eyes, the sun was a bit dazzling, and she put her arms across her eyes.

    It only took a moment for her to realize something was wrong.

    Her shabby rental house was exposed to the west and could not see the morning sun at all.

    This is not her home.

    Tong Yu finally woke up a little, and his mind was working quickly, recalling what happened last night.

    Scenes emerged in my mind, and in the end only one name remained.

    Huo Fang!

    Some memories came back to me, and I became more and more awake.

    She suddenly looked to her side, and the man's handsome face magnified in front of her eyes.

    Breath hitched.

    That's not a dream!

    Tong Yu finally realized what he had done. Before his mind could figure out what to do, his body had already made a decision.

    She got out of bed, picked up the clothes on the floor, covered her chest and hurried out barefoot, for fear of being stopped by the people inside.

    I got dressed at the door and went out with all my energy.

    …

    Tong Yu went to work at [Yunshang].

    For three days, Tong Yu didn't see Huo Fang.

    Thinking about it, people like him probably wouldn't come to a place like this every day.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 3 Last night seemed not to be a dream
